description: Read a case's summary: what it holds, the results attached to it and where they point. Read-only: it never runs an analysis and never spends credits. Reads the scene only (architecture, signage, terrain, vegetation), never the people in it. No face recognition, no biometric identification, no person matching. It answers where an image was taken, never who is in it, and must not be used to locate or track a person.
name: get_case
title: Summarize an Oceanir case
